evidence: Portainer on peasec-gpu-01 shows both retained training images at 8.8 GB each; counted separately with 10 GB allowed per image even though layers may be shared. SFTPGo is 272.2 MB, the extraction Python image 74.7 MB; 0.1 GB also reserved for the earlier Alpine check. These images, bounded rotated task logs (10 MiB x 3 per task), and 5 GB extra image/log headroom fit within 26 GB. Training and transfer roots are read-only; no image build or package install is part of this run. The existing pipeline builds in a separate Docker-in-Docker CI runner; shared GitLab/registry infrastructure is not counted as this GPU-host project allocation. No claim of measuring its global caches is made. The transfer state volume measured 524672 KiB (537264128 bytes) with du -sk; 2 GB is allowed for it and small service metadata. Main runtime caches, worker logs, preflight reports, earlier benchmarks and all exports are counted inside the guarded results volume; all input archives, old preserved package and helpers are counted inside the input volume. The plan keeps full 30 GB image/log and 15 GB other allowances, plus 5 GB inputs and 200 GB outputs, totaling 250 decimal GB. This is a checked operational envelope, not an administrator disk quota.
